The following analysis is based on eighty public benchmark datasets from five public foundation model evaluation frameworks eva [ 27 ] , HEST [ 34 ] , Plismbench [ 22 ] , PathoROB [ 46 ] , and Patho-Bench [ 81 ] as well as additional tumor-micro-environment (TME) and MSI prediction benchmark datasets. The tasks range from TME tissue- and cell-typing over identifying morphological patterns, identifying cancer subtypes, to predicting gene mutations from histology. The evaluation protocols and task descriptions are detailed in Section 3.3 and Appendix A.1 , respectively.
